_comment: Per-container-type model + effort defaults. Layered like versions.env: this tracked file is the base, and an untracked ~/.research-sandbox/model-defaults.json overrides it PER KEY (a partial override file is fine — only the types it names are replaced). Every type resolves independently; there is no inheritance between types. The four project types are also overridable per-invocation at project create, box add, and the dev card; `reviewer` (the ephemeral dev-lane reviewer) has no per-invocation knob — it is read live at each review run and edited from Management → Infrastructure → Reviewer (rscore.model_default_set writes the override).
